source_restriction: Doc25 Raw + components only; no GT, no Raw+wires, no OCR engines
review_notes: Raw schematic was treated as authoritative; detected-components overlay/crops were used only to localize components and repeated structures.
No OCR engine was used. Labels were manually read from the provided raw/overlay crops in the allowed Raw + components folder.
Solid lines were encoded as power/dc_power; dashed lines as control_trip; dotted instrument drops as signal; ground symbols as ground edges.
Crossings without visible bus-tap dots were not asserted as connections; small/ambiguous trip/control and feeder-source candidates are listed in uncertain_edges.
The A/B/C feeder trains and MCC branch patterns are highly repeated; evidence strings note the visible repeated branch location where applicable.
